Nilpotent Quotients This chapter contains a description of the nilpotent quotient algorithm for associative finitely presented algebras. We refer to for background on the algorithms used in this chapter.
Computing nilpotent quotients Let A be a finitely presented algebra in the &GAP; sense. The following function can be used to determine the class-c nilpotent quotient of A. The quotient is described by a nilpotent table.
The output of this function is a nilpotent table with some additional entries. In particular, there is the additional entry img which describes the images of the generators of A in the nilpotent table.
Example of nilpotent quotient computation
gap> F := FreeAssociativeAlgebra(GF(2), 2);; gap> g := GeneratorsOfAlgebra(F);; gap> r := [g[1]^2, g[2]^2];; gap> A := F/r;; gap> NilpotentQuotientOfFpAlgebra(A,3); rec( def := [ 1, 2 ], dim := 8, fld := GF(2), img := [ <a GF2 vector of length 8>, <a GF2 vector of length 8> ], mat := [ [ ], [ ] ], rnk := 2, tab := [ [ <a GF2 vector of length 8>, <a GF2 vector of length 8>, [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), Z(2)^0, 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ], [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ], [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ], [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), Z(2)^0 ], [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ], [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ] ] , [ <a GF2 vector of length 8>, <a GF2 vector of length 8>, [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ], [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), Z(2)^0, 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ], [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), Z(2)^0, 0*Z(2) ], [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ], [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ], [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ] ] , [ [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ], [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), Z(2)^0, 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ] ] , [ [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), Z(2)^0, 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ], [ 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2), 0*Z(2) ] ] ], wds := [ ,, [ 2, 1 ], [ 1, 2 ], [ 1, 3 ], [ 2, 4 ], [ 2, 5 ], [ 1, 6 ] ], wgs := [ 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4 ] )
